rationale: Genome-wide Brunello knockout screen in RLT-PSC pancreatic stellate (CAF-like) cells sorted on surface JAM-A. Columns map one to one to the GSM titles (Replicate 1/2: Unsorted, High, Low JAM-A). The paper asks which knockouts raise JAM-A, so the primary analysis is High vs Low: guides enriched in the High bin mark negative regulators of JAM-A (ZEB1). The two replicates are separate sorts; a replicate term would leave 1 residual df, so it is left out (2 residual df). The library carries only 4 guides labelled CTRL (Brunello's 1,000 non-targeting guides are not identifiable in the deposited table), so control calibration and the control null cannot be used.
